prompt: Create src/index.ts exporting `evaluate(rules: Rule[], facts: Record<string, number>): string[]` and the type Rule. A Rule is { name: string; when: string; then: string; priority?: number }. `when` is a condition of the form '<key> <op> <number>' where op is one of > < >= <= == !=. `then` is an assignment of the form '<key> = <number>'. Evaluation: repeatedly scan all rules; a rule fires if its condition is true against the CURRENT facts AND firing would change the value it assigns. Among all firable rules pick the one with the highest priority (default 0); ties break by earliest index. Apply it, append its name to the output, and rescan. Stop when nothing can fire or after 100 firings, whichever comes first. Facts are mutated in place. Throw a SyntaxError for a malformed when or then.
